headline: A 2022 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs move a legally designated name from one VA property to another similar property under set conditions.
what_it_does: Some VA facilities, buildings, or wings were named by an act of Congress. This law allows the VA to transfer that name to another VA property if the original property no longer offers benefits or services, the new property is similar in type and purpose, and the new property is at a different address in the same town or city named in the original law. The VA must notify Congress of its plan at least 30 days before the transfer happens.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 7, 2022. Any actual name transfer must occur at least 30 days after the VA notifies Congress.
